A small fix on top of 4.2.0.

## Fixed

- After honeybee restarted, finished Codex sessions showed "just now". They now show when their last turn really ended, and sessions saved with the wrong time are corrected.

## Install

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `honeybee-4.2.1-win-x64-setup.exe`, or `…-portable.exe` |
| macOS Apple silicon | `honeybee-4.2.1-mac-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS Intel | `honeybee-4.2.1-mac-x64.dmg` |
| Linux x64 / arm64 | `.AppImage` or `.deb` |

The builds are unsigned. On Windows choose **More info → Run anyway**. On macOS right-click → **Open**.
